business_summary: Xinhua News Media Holdings Limited, an investment holding company, provides cleaning and related services in Hong Kong. It operates in three segments: Cleaning and Related Services, Advertising Media Business, and Waste Treatment Business. The Cleaning and Related Services segment offers cleaning and related services for industrial and residential buildings, shopping malls and arcades, public transport facilities, airline catering companies, laundry workshops, public leisure venues, schools, hospitals, service apartments, and markets. Its Advertising Media Business segment provides media strategy, planning and management, product launching and selling, brand building, and event marketing services, as well as develops and operates advertising media. The Waste Treatment Business segment provides organic waste treatment services, as well as sells the by-products produced. The company also engages in the broadcast of information on installed outdoor and indoor television screens; provision of content for mobile screens in public transportation facilities; solid and medical waste treatment; technology, media, and telecommunications activities; and property agency and investment businesses. In addition, it provides organic liquid fertilizers and solid pellets under the Fertilife brand; environmental services, including collection and disposal of domestic, industrial, and construction wastes, as well as gully, grease trap, cesspool, and drainage dislodging and clearance services; pest control; external wall cleaning and repairs; stone maintenance and restoration; and external wall and outdoor synthetic detergents under the Sparkling brand. The company was formerly known as Lo's Enviro-Pro Holdings Limited and changed its name to Xinhua News Media Holdings Limited in May 2011. Xinhua News Media Holdings Limited was founded in 1975 and is headquartered in Central, Hong Kong.
business_summary_ko: 투자 지주 회사인 Xinhua News Media Holdings Limited는 홍콩에서 청소 및 관련 서비스를 제공합니다. 청소 및 관련 서비스, 광고 미디어 사업, 폐기물 처리 사업 등 3개 부문으로 운영됩니다. 청소 및 관련 서비스 부문은 산업 및 주거용 건물, 쇼핑몰 및 아케이드, 대중 교통 시설, 항공 케이터링 회사, 세탁소, 공공 레저 장소, 학교, 병원, 서비스 아파트 및 시장에 대한 청소 및 관련 서비스를 제공합니다. 광고미디어사업부는 미디어 전략, 기획 및 관리, 제품 출시 및 판매, 브랜드 구축, 이벤트 마케팅 서비스를 제공하고 광고미디어를 개발 및 운영합니다. 폐기물 처리 사업 부문은 유기성 폐기물 처리 서비스를 제공하고 생산된 부산물을 판매합니다. 회사는 또한 설치된 실외 및 실내 TV 화면에 대한 정보 방송에도 참여합니다. 대중교통 시설의 모바일 화면용 콘텐츠 제공; 고체 및 의료 폐기물 처리; 기술, 미디어 및 통신 활동; 부동산 중개업 및 투자업
